questions.text: What revenue, segment results and capital investment do public reports disclose, and which AI-specific allocations remain unavailable?
What funding and compute relationships are announced, and what evidence distinguishes equity, debt, cloud credits, commitments and recognized revenue?
What do official API/consumer prices and commercial terms establish, without inferring private margins, realized compute costs or retention?
How do selected English and Brazilian Portuguese reports frame common disclosures, without counting repeated reporting as independent financial corroboration or internet-wide sentiment?

exclusions: No overall internet sentiment, representative population/cohort percentages or inferred private company economics.
No HN voting/comment sample, X/Reddit/LinkedIn data, private posts, personal sessions or product Brain memory.
Other firms/investors mentioned in articles are context, not independently qualified entity panels.
No exhaustive funding history, latest-state financing totals or deduced cash/credit/equity allocation.
No estimates of private recognized revenue, realized compute cost, operating/gross margin or net retention.
No paid/API/model/classification calls, recurring collection, deployment or editorial-publication authority.
